title: Learning to Correct Geometry in Generated Videos
headline: Fixing Geometric Drift in Video Generation: Data-Driven Corrections for Consistent Viewpoints
tldr: Generated videos often lose geometric consistency under camera motion, causing warped structures and inconsistent parallax. This paper shows that the issue stems mainly from data biases and proposes a data-driven correction method that restores spatial coherence.
significance: Improving geometric fidelity in video synthesis enhances realism and reliability for downstream applications like AR/VR and visual storytelling.

title: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
headline: Pixel Diffusion Transformers: Direct Image Generation Without Latent Bottlenecks in Pixel Space
tldr: JiT demonstrates that a vanilla diffusion transformer can generate images directly in pixel space by replacing the usual velocity prediction with clean image prediction. This eliminates the need for a lossy latent bottleneck and a separately trained autoencoder, simplifying the pipeline.
significance: This approach streamlines diffusion-based image synthesis, potentially improving fidelity and reducing computational overhead.

title: Flashing with colours: Photometric indicators of an early interaction in type II supernovae
headline: Early Interaction Signals in Type II Supernovae Revealed by Rapid Photometry
tldr: We combine near-daily, high-precision optical photometry of 86 type II supernovae to identify early photometric signatures of circumstellar interaction. The study demonstrates that early color evolution can serve as a diagnostic for progenitor mass loss and explosion physics.
significance: This work provides a new, statistically robust method to probe early supernova environments, informing models of massive star evolution.

title: Bad Diagnosis: Analyzing Consent and Data Collection Practices of Mobile Medical Apps
headline: Unveiling Consent Gaps: 10,000+ mHealth Apps Exposed and Data Practices Revealed
tldr: We analyzed consent and data collection across 10,000+ mHealth apps on Google Play, revealing widespread privacy gaps and inconsistent data handling. The study highlights the need for stricter regulations and better transparency in mobile health applications.
significance: This work provides the first large-scale evidence of privacy shortcomings in mHealth apps, informing policymakers and developers.

title: Entering the Era of Circumplanetary Ring Detection with Direct Imaging
headline: Detecting Exoplanet Rings: A New Frontier in Direct Imaging Observations
tldr: Rings around giant planets are common in our Solar System, but detecting them around exoplanets remains challenging. Upcoming missions like the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will need to account for ring effects to accurately interpret reflected light data.
significance: Understanding circumplanetary rings is essential for correctly characterizing exoplanet atmospheres and potential habitability.

title: Blind Precise Assembly: Proprioceptive Sim-to-Real Peg-in-Hole for Diverse Parts
headline: Proprioceptive Sim-to-Real Peg-in-Hole: Blind Precise Assembly Using Joint Sensors for Diverse Parts
tldr: This work demonstrates that high-resolution joint encoders alone can guide a robot to perform millimeter-scale peg-in-hole tasks without visual feedback. By training a proprioceptive policy in simulation and transferring it to real hardware, the robot reliably aligns and inserts diverse parts under blind conditions.
significance: It shows that proprioception can replace vision for fine assembly, reducing cost and complexity in robotic manufacturing.

title: Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models
headline: Fine-Tuning Sparks Unexpected Behaviors and Synergies in Large Language Models
tldr: Fine-tuning LLMs can trigger unintended behaviors, revealing behavioral couplings. This study maps these emergent effects.
significance: Understanding behavioral couplings informs safer model fine-tuning practices.

title: Identifiability from Moments in Independent Component Analysis Mixture Models
headline: Unveiling Identifiability in ICA Mixture Models via Moment Analysis for Statistical Modeling
tldr: This paper demonstrates that ICA mixture models, which generalize Gaussian mixtures, can be uniquely identified from their moments under broad conditions. The authors provide theoretical guarantees and illustrate the implications for nonparametric density estimation.
significance: By establishing moment-based identifiability, the work bridges a gap between ICA theory and practical mixture modeling, enabling more reliable inference in high-dimensional data.

title: AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery
headline: LLM Agents Automate Reproducibility and Robustness in Cancer Research Using SEER
tldr: We demonstrate that large language model agents can automatically reproduce and assess the analytical robustness of scientific findings, reducing manual effort. In a case study on SEER cancer data, the agents replicated key analyses and identified potential biases, showcasing a scalable approach to reproducibility.
significance: This work shows that LLM agents can transform reproducibility from a labor-intensive task into an automated, scalable process, accelerating scientific discovery.

title: ModeCast: One-Shot Prediction of Linear MHD Eigenmodes and Growth Rates in Tokamaks
headline: ModeCast: Rapid One-Shot Prediction of Tokamak MHD Instabilities Using Machine Learning
tldr: ModeCast delivers instant linear stability assessments for tokamak plasmas, replacing hours-long simulations. Trained on thousands of JOREK runs, it predicts eigenmodes and growth rates in a single forward pass.
significance: By enabling real-time stability analysis, ModeCast accelerates fusion design cycles and reduces computational costs.

title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
headline: Diagnosing Goal Grounding Failures in Vision‑Language Model Navigation for Object‑Goal Tasks
tldr: Fine‑tuned vision‑language models excel at exploration but struggle to correctly ground target objects, limiting success in object‑goal navigation. Our study pinpoints goal grounding as the primary bottleneck and suggests targeted improvements.
significance: Understanding the root cause of low success rates in VLM‑based navigation guides the development of more reliable autonomous agents.

title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
headline: OmniVerifier-C1: Fine-Grained Decomposition of Rule-Governed Generative Visual Verifiers for Robust Multimodal Intelligence
tldr: OmniVerifier-C1 introduces a graded verifier that decomposes complex prompts and environmental rules into fine-grained components, moving beyond binary judgments. This approach enhances robustness and compositional reasoning in multimodal generative world modeling.
significance: It enables more nuanced verification of generative models, improving reliability in complex multimodal tasks.

title: LSST and Keck characterization of outer Main Belt comet P/2026 N2
headline: LSST and Keck Reveal Persistent Activity of Outer Main Belt Comet P/2026 N2
tldr: Using LSST optical data and Keck/LRIS imaging, we tracked comet P/2026 N2’s active morphology across 102 days around perihelion. Dynamical integrations confirm its outer Main Belt orbit and ongoing activity, highlighting the importance of coordinated surveys.
significance: This study demonstrates the power of combining wide-field survey data with targeted high-resolution imaging to monitor cometary activity in the outer Main Belt.

title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
headline: Rethinking Routing Exploration for Efficient Modern Mixture‑of‑Experts Models in Large Language Systems
tldr: The paper critiques existing routing strategies in Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE) models, highlighting trade‑offs between expressiveness and activation efficiency. It introduces a novel routing exploration technique that balances these factors, achieving better accuracy and speed on standard benchmarks.
significance: By redefining how tokens are routed to experts, the study enables larger, more efficient MoE models that can be deployed in real‑world AI applications.

title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
headline: SUPRA-TEX: Super-Aligned Texture for Realistic 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image
tldr: SUPRA‑TEX introduces a novel approach that aligns texture across views to produce photorealistic, relightable 3D meshes from a single image. By fusing multi‑view predictions without artifacts and preserving fine details through implicit conditioning, it outperforms existing methods on benchmark datasets.
significance: It advances single-image 3D reconstruction, enabling high-fidelity, relightable models for applications in AR/VR and digital content creation.

title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
headline: FDE-Gym: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World Delivery Tasks for Forward-Deployed Engineers
tldr: We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks spanning 20 customer scenarios, designed to evaluate AI agents in realistic, ambiguous, live-system contexts. This benchmark pushes agents beyond well-specified tasks, requiring clarification of requirements and discovery of unstated constraints.
significance: FDE-Gym provides the first large-scale, realistic testbed for AI agents, bridging the gap between controlled benchmarks and real-world engineering deployments.

title: Singles in Disguise: Kepler's Low-SNR Single-Transiting Systems as Incompletely Detected Multis
headline: Kepler Singles May Be Hidden Multiplanet Systems, Not a Separate Population
tldr: Kepler’s excess of single transiting planets can be explained by detection biases that miss additional low‑signal planets. The study shows that many singles are actually incomplete detections of multi‑planet systems, challenging the idea of a distinct single‑planet population.
significance: This finding reshapes our understanding of planetary system architectures and suggests that apparent single‑planet systems may largely be incomplete multi‑planet systems.

title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
headline: Speculative Forcing Accelerates Autoregressive Video Generation for Real-Time Streaming without Extra Computation
tldr: Speculative Forcing selectively skips the final denoising step for tokens that already converge, reducing compute while maintaining quality. This approach speeds up few-step autoregressive video generators, enabling efficient real-time streaming.
significance: It allows video generation models to run faster and more efficiently, making real-time streaming practical.

title: Projected sensitivity of a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate comagnetometer to proton monopole-dipole interactions
headline: Spinor BEC Comagnetometer Probes Proton Monopole-Dipole Forces Below Millimeter Scale
tldr: The study projects that a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate comagnetometer can directly constrain proton monopole-dipole interactions at sub‑millimeter ranges, surpassing current neutron‑based limits. This sensitivity opens a new window for detecting light spin‑zero bosons that violate parity and time‑reversal symmetry.
significance: It provides the first direct laboratory limits on proton‑mediated monopole‑dipole forces at short distances, advancing searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model.

title: Spark-0: Scaling Spatially Aligned Tactile Pretraining for Robot Dexterous Manipulation
headline: Spark-0: Spatially Aligned Vision‑Tactile Pretraining for Dexterous Robot Manipulation and Control
tldr: Spark‑0 introduces a vision‑tactile‑language‑action model that aligns tactile contact maps with image space, enabling robots to learn dexterous manipulation tasks from large‑scale pretraining. The model demonstrates improved performance on contact‑rich tasks and offers an open‑source benchmark for future research.
significance: By integrating tactile signals directly into a spatially aligned pretraining framework, Spark‑0 advances the capability of generalist robot policies to handle fine‑grained, contact‑rich manipulation tasks.

title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
headline: 3DCodeVerse: Scalable 3D Content Creation via Coding Agents
tldr: We present 3DCodeVerse, an ecosystem that lets coding agents generate editable, verifiable 3D content at scale. It includes a large curated dataset, a harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding.
significance: 3DCodeVerse enables rapid, reliable development of complex 3D scenes, accelerating research and applications in virtual worlds and simulation.

title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
headline: Robots Learn Dexterity by Playing: Autonomous Data Collection via Supervised Play
tldr: DSP trains a play policy from minutes of human play using behavior cloning, then lets the robot autonomously gather hours of interaction data to build a world model. During deployment, the same play policy guides the robot to perform dexterous tasks in real time.
significance: This approach dramatically reduces the data needed to train robots for complex manipulation, enabling rapid, scalable skill acquisition.

title: Geospatial & AI Trends: Highlights from 2025 - Geoawesome
headline: 2025 GeoAI Trends: Predictive Insights, Automation, and Climate Solutions for Cities and Global Challenges
tldr: 2025 sees GeoAI harnessing satellite imagery and LLMs to forecast climate impacts and optimize urban planning. Emerging diffusion models and real‑time point‑cloud analytics empower proactive disaster response and sustainable agriculture.
significance: These advances enable data‑driven decision making that can mitigate climate risks and improve resource allocation worldwide.

title: GeoAI | Geo Week News
headline: AI and Machine Learning Transform Geospatial Work: From Feature Extraction to Predictive Analysis
tldr: Artificial intelligence and machine learning are revolutionizing geospatial workflows by automating feature extraction, classifying point clouds, and enabling predictive analytics across the data pipeline. GeoAI blends AI with imagery, LiDAR, and spatial datasets at scale, unlocking new applications in mapping, monitoring, and decision-making.
significance: These advances accelerate insight generation, reduce manual effort, and empower real-time decision-making in diverse sectors.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Charting the Future of GeoAI: Emerging Trends and Next-Gen Opportunities
tldr: GeoAI blends geospatial science with AI, rapidly evolving across spatial data science. The paper reviews recent advances and projects future directions.
significance: Understanding GeoAI’s trajectory is crucial for leveraging AI in spatial decision-making and policy.

title: GeoAI and the Next Generation of Geospatial Insights - Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Insight: AI, Data, and Sensing Merge for Smarter Mapping
tldr: Artificial intelligence is reshaping geospatial analysis by merging data, sensing, and AI. GeoAI promises faster, more accurate mapping and decision-making across industries.
significance: GeoAI will transform how organizations collect, analyze, and act on spatial data, enabling real-time insights and smarter resource management.

title: ACMSIGSPATIAL-GEOAI 2025 - Conference Tagline
headline: Harnessing Deep Learning for Geospatial Insight: AI Meets Multimodal Data
tldr: The conference showcases breakthroughs in AI and hardware that enable automated learning from massive multimodal geospatial data. These advances transform societal challenges across urban planning, agriculture, and disaster response.
significance: By integrating cutting‑edge deep learning with multimodal geospatial data, the event accelerates solutions for real‑world problems.

title: Tech for Earth: Latest News in GeoAI and Earth Observation
headline: Geospatial Tech Builds Earth’s New Nervous System for Real-Time Climate Monitoring
tldr: High‑resolution satellites and AI are creating a real‑time monitoring network that tracks climate change. Copernicus data show 2025 as the third warmest year, underscoring the urgency.
significance: This integrated system enables rapid, data‑driven responses to environmental threats.

title: remote-sensing · GitHub Topics · GitHub
headline: Remote Sensing Change Detection Resources: Datasets, Tools, Methods, and Competitions
tldr: This repository compiles the latest datasets, tools, methods, review papers, and competitions for remote sensing change detection. It serves as a go-to reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to stay current in the field.
significance: It accelerates research and application development by centralizing critical resources for detecting changes in satellite imagery.

title: GeoAI: Artificial Intelligence for Geospatial Data - GitHub
headline: GeoAI Toolkit: Automating Satellite Imagery Processing and AI Training Data Generation
tldr: This open-source GitHub repository provides streamlined tools for downloading, mosaicking, and preprocessing satellite imagery, as well as automated generation of labeled training datasets for AI models. It also includes vector-to-raster conversion utilities, data augmentation techniques, and supports various remote sensing formats like Sentinel, Landsat, and NAIP.
significance: By simplifying geospatial data preparation, GeoAI accelerates AI research and deployment in earth observation applications.

title: Home - GeoAI
headline: GeoAI: Integrating AI with Geospatial Data for Powerful Analysis and Visualization
tldr: GeoAI is a Python package that bridges artificial intelligence and geospatial analysis, offering intuitive tools for machine learning on spatial data. It supports visualization, segmentation, and real-time applications across satellite imagery and point clouds.
significance: GeoAI democratizes advanced AI techniques for geospatial tasks, enabling researchers to quickly prototype and deploy models on real-world data.

title: 13 Open Source Remote Sensing Software Packages
headline: Explore 13 Free Remote Sensing Tools for Satellite Image Analysis
tldr: This article lists 13 open‑source remote sensing applications, outlining their key features and use cases. It helps researchers and hobbyists quickly choose the right tool for satellite image processing.
significance: Open‑source software democratizes access to advanced geospatial analysis, enabling broader scientific and community-driven innovation.

title: remote sensing free download - SourceForge
headline: Free Remote Sensing Resources on SourceForge: Code, Papers, and Practical Tools
tldr: SourceForge hosts a comprehensive guide offering free remote sensing datasets, code snippets, and research links. Ideal for researchers, engineers, and enthusiasts seeking practical tools in geospatial AI.
significance: This free resource accelerates development and experimentation in remote sensing and geospatial AI.

title: Open Source Software - The Geological Remote Sensing Group (GRSG)
headline: GRSG Unites Open-Source Tools for Advanced Remote Sensing Analysis Worldwide
tldr: The Geological Remote Sensing Group (GRSG) aggregates free geospatial software and libraries to support sophisticated image processing across optical, multispectral, SAR, and hyperspectral data. This open-source ecosystem empowers researchers and professionals to conduct advanced remote sensing analyses without costly proprietary tools.
significance: GRSG democratizes access to cutting‑edge remote sensing capabilities, accelerating scientific discovery and practical applications worldwide.

title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
headline: LIBERO-PeRM: A New Benchmark for Personalized Robotic Manipulation
tldr: LIBERO-PeRM introduces a controlled benchmark that separates task completion from preference satisfaction in household robotics. It enables systematic evaluation of personalization algorithms in embodied settings.
significance: It provides the first standardized framework to assess how well robots adapt to individual user preferences while performing tasks.

title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
headline: Gen4P: Turning Video Generators into Real-Time 4D Perceivers for Geometry and Motion
tldr: Gen4P repurposes pretrained video generators into a feed-forward 4D perceiver, enabling rapid recovery of 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. By processing clean video latents in a single encoder pass and using lightweight cross-attention decoding, it eliminates iterative denoising and supports on-demand querying.
significance: This approach dramatically speeds up 4D scene understanding, making it feasible for real-time applications.

title: Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation
headline: Efficient Diffusion via Token Merging: Preserving Prompt-Aligning Foreground Tokens for Image Generation
tldr: Token merging reduces redundant computation in diffusion models while keeping image quality high. The new method keeps prompt-aligned foreground tokens, ensuring critical details remain intact during generation.
significance: This approach enables faster, resource-efficient image synthesis without sacrificing fidelity, advancing practical deployment of diffusion models.

title: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers
headline: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Faster Diffusion Transformer Generation
tldr: SoftCache introduces a training-free caching mechanism that reuses activations across iterative steps in diffusion transformers, reducing computation. By monitoring a lightweight staleness signal, it dynamically refreshes cached activations to maintain accuracy while speeding up generation.
significance: This approach dramatically cuts inference time for diffusion models, enabling real-time applications without retraining.

title: Value as Memory: Online Value-Guided Post-training for General Robot Policies
headline: Value as Memory: Enhancing Robot Policies with Online Reinforcement Learning
tldr: Value as Memory (VaM) introduces a value caching mechanism that conditions action selection on recent experiences, mitigating partial observability. By integrating online real‑world RL, VaM provides immediate feedback, accelerating post‑training of generalist robot policies.
significance: VaM bridges the gap between offline policy training and real‑world deployment, enabling faster, more reliable robot learning.

title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
headline: Large Language Models Accelerate Quantum Circuit Design
tldr: Researchers harness large language models to generate and optimize quantum circuits, achieving state‑of‑the‑art performance on benchmark problems. This approach reduces the need for manual circuit design and accelerates the development of quantum algorithms.
significance: It demonstrates that foundation models can effectively tackle complex quantum optimization tasks, paving the way for scalable quantum algorithm development.

title: $^6$He structure from semiclassical 3D models based on $\textit{ab initio}$ spatial correlations
headline: Semiclassical 3D Models Reveal Distorted Alpha Core in Helium-6
tldr: Using ab initio no-core shell model correlations, we build semiclassical 3D models of ^6He. The models show that two valence neutrons flatten the alpha core, deviating from the tetrahedral shape of a free alpha particle.
significance: This work provides a clearer picture of how valence neutrons influence the structure of light halo nuclei, aiding future nuclear theory and experiment.

title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
headline: Optimizing Hidden Environment Factors at Test Time for Accurate Robotic World Models
tldr: Robots need to predict world responses to actions, but many environmental factors are hidden. T2-Z introduces a method to optimize latent environmental variables during test time, improving world model predictions without retraining.
significance: T2-Z enables robots to adapt to unseen environmental conditions on the fly, enhancing reliability in dynamic real-world settings.

title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
headline: Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation: Perceive, Predict, Plan
tldr: We present P³-WAM, a unified model that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning for egocentric dexterous manipulation. The system reconstructs hand motion and camera trajectories, predicts visual futures under actions, and jointly generates plans for manipulation tasks.
significance: P³-WAM advances robotic manipulation by integrating perception, prediction, and planning into a single framework, enabling more realistic and efficient egocentric manipulation.

title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
headline: CoDA: Co-Evolving Simulation Engines and Policies for Targeted Robot Training
tldr: CoDA proposes a dynamic loop where a generative simulation engine and a robot action policy iteratively refine each other via a shared memory of diverse environments. This approach focuses on generating only those scenarios that expose policy weaknesses, accelerating learning and improving real-world performance.
significance: By aligning environment generation with policy deficiencies, CoDA reduces sample waste and speeds up deployment of robust autonomous agents.

title: Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content
headline: Verifying 3D Generative Models: Grounding Output with Spatial Evidence for Robustness
tldr: This paper introduces a verification framework that uses 3D evidence to assess the correctness of generative outputs, moving beyond visual fidelity. It demonstrates how feedback loops can identify unmet task-specific requirements, improving reliability of 3D AI systems.
significance: By integrating verification into 3D generation pipelines, the work addresses a critical gap in ensuring model outputs meet real-world constraints, paving the way for trustworthy deployment.

title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
headline: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting for Multivariate Trajectories
tldr: PathFM introduces a fast generative model that captures the full dependence structure of multivariate time‑series trajectories, enabling accurate predictions of cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing. The method outperforms existing marginal‑quantile approaches while remaining computationally efficient.
significance: By modeling trajectory dependence, PathFM provides more reliable forecasts for applications that rely on joint behavior of multiple variables.

title: Stability of Quantum LDPC States under Local Pauli Noise
headline: Assessing the Robustness of Quantum LDPC States Against Local Pauli Noise
tldr: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes feature a mixed state that is central to both error correction and many-body physics. Recent studies reveal how local Pauli noise affects the spatial decay of correlations, challenging the stability of these states.
significance: Understanding noise resilience in qLDPC codes is crucial for reliable quantum information processing and for exploring new phases of mixed quantum matter.

title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
headline: DK-VLM: Using Geometry as Position for Enhanced Spatial Reasoning in Vision‑Language Models
tldr: DK-VLM introduces Dual‑Kernel Attention that treats 3D geometry as positional embeddings, enabling vision‑language models to update spatial judgments as the observer moves. The method aligns 3D reconstruction features with pretrained semantics, improving cross‑view spatial understanding under limited supervision.
significance: It bridges the gap between 3D spatial perception and language grounding, advancing the capability of vision‑language models to reason about real‑world geometry.

title: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
headline: Using 3D Language Models to Enhance Novel-View Generation from Sparse Observations
tldr: The paper explores whether answering spatial questions with 3D language models can improve the realism and spatial consistency of novel view synthesis. Experiments show that integrating high-level semantic and spatial reasoning yields better view generation than geometry-only baselines.
significance: It demonstrates that language-based spatial reasoning can be a powerful tool for 3D scene reconstruction, bridging vision and language.

title: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
headline: SafeDriveVLA: Conflict-Aware Navigation Using Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: SafeDriveVLA integrates a vision-language-action model with a world‑model dreaming framework to generate conflict‑aware driving policies from free‑form natural‑language instructions. The system detects unsafe driver commands in real time and adapts vehicle behavior accordingly.
significance: This approach demonstrates how large language models can be safely leveraged for autonomous navigation, reducing the risk of unsafe driver instructions.

title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
headline: Diffusion Models Unveil Neural Weight Distributions for Humanoid Control Policies
tldr: Researchers apply diffusion models to learn the distribution of neural weights in humanoid control networks, enabling generation of functional policies without explicit training. This approach offers insights into policy structure and opens avenues for rapid deployment and adaptation.
significance: By modeling weight distributions, the study provides a scalable method to generate and analyze humanoid policies, potentially accelerating robot learning and deployment.

title: Representation Conditioning for Generation
headline: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Vision Encoder Representation Alignment for Image Generation Tasks
tldr: Representation-alignment methods speed up diffusion transformer training by importing semantics from a pretrained vision encoder. REPA, for example, uses an MLP projection head to supervise intermediate layers, discarding the head after training to embed richer visual features into the diffusion backbone.
significance: This approach enables faster, more semantically grounded diffusion models without additional inference overhead.

title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
headline: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning Enables Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
tldr: We introduce HiRe-MoMa, a hierarchical residual policy framework that stabilizes and accelerates real‑world fine‑tuning of mobile manipulation systems. By leveraging sparse human demonstrations and modular residual learning, the method achieves sample‑efficient adaptation across high‑dimensional action spaces.
significance: This work bridges the gap between simulation and deployment, enabling rapid, data‑efficient adaptation of complex robotic manipulation pipelines in real environments.

title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moiré graphene
headline: Moiré Graphene Hosts Nodal Nematic Superconductivity, Revealing Rotational Symmetry Breaking
tldr: Recent experiments on moiré graphene layers have uncovered nodal nematic superconductivity, a state where the superconducting gap vanishes along lines while simultaneously breaking rotational symmetry. This discovery provides a new platform to study exotic pairing mechanisms beyond conventional s‑wave superconductors.
significance: It opens a promising avenue for exploring unconventional superconductivity mechanisms and could inform the design of next‑generation quantum materials.

title: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
headline: From Visual Motion to Precise Action: Training Driving Models Directly on Visual Dynamics
tldr: VITAL proposes deriving action targets directly from visual motion, bypassing separate trajectory representations. By reconstructing trajectories from future images, the model learns to anticipate driving decisions in real time.
significance: This approach bridges the gap between visual perception and action planning, enabling more accurate and responsive autonomous driving systems.

title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
headline: CommerceGen-Studio: End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main Image Generation
tldr: CommerceGen-Studio introduces a three-stage pipeline—information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation—to produce high-quality main images for e-commerce SKUs. The PERL-Agent distills heterogeneous metadata into concise selling-point text lists, enabling efficient and scalable image creation.
significance: It streamlines the creation of commercial-grade product images, reducing time and cost for e-commerce businesses.

title: Heavy-Heavy-Light-Light correlators from holography on the worldsheet
headline: Holographic Correlators of Heavy and Light Operators on AdS2 Worldsheet
tldr: We compute heavy-heavy-light-light correlators for defect-changing operators in the 1/2 BPS Wilson line of N=4 SYM. The analysis reveals how large scaling dimensions back-react on the AdS2 worldsheet, providing a holographic description of cusp deformations.
significance: This work extends holographic techniques to study defect operators with large dimensions, offering new insights into the dynamics of Wilson line defects in AdS/CFT.

title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
headline: DynThinker Bridges Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning for Unified Intelligence
tldr: DynThinker introduces a model that simultaneously handles static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial tasks, overcoming the interference that hampers existing approaches. By selectively fine‑tuning parameter groups, it achieves balanced performance across both domains.
significance: This work provides a scalable framework that enables robust spatial intelligence across static and dynamic contexts, paving the way for advanced applications in robotics, autonomous navigation, and geospatial analytics.

title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
headline: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting Boosts Language Agent Efficiency for Long-Horizon Tasks
tldr: The paper introduces a method that jointly trains language agents to act and forecast intermediate states, reducing reliance on costly rollouts. By leveraging per-step supervision, the approach improves sample efficiency and performance on long-horizon tasks.
significance: It offers a scalable alternative to traditional RL, enabling more efficient training of language agents for complex, multi-step tasks.

title: CoWear: Towards Collaborative Wearable Inertial Localization with Multiple Smart Devices
headline: CoWear: Collaborative Inertial Localization Dataset for Multi-Device Smart Wearables and Glasses
tldr: CoWear provides synchronized inertial data from smartphones, smartwatches, and smart glasses, along with device-specific motion ground truth. The dataset enables benchmarking and development of collaborative localization algorithms for wearable devices.
significance: It fills a gap in inertial localization research by offering a realistic, multi-device dataset with synchronized ground truth.
